newsletter.markdown:
1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

- **[Biotech]** **[NR4A2 target biology reviewed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42901401/)** — *PubMed*
  - Summarizes the emerging role of nuclear receptor subfamily 4 group A member 2 (NR4A2) in orchestrating dynamic gene regulation and protein interactions across therapeutic areas.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

- **[Biotech]** **[Rapport Therapeutics reports Phase II success for RAP-219](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/rapport-bipolar-mania-clinical-trial-rap-219-results/833454/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - Experimental daily oral pill RAP-219 narrowly met the primary endpoint in a ~250-patient mid-stage study for bipolar mania, achieving a 15.4-point symptom scale improvement versus 12.3 for placebo (p = 0.031).
  - Patients treated with the drug demonstrated numerical improvements across all 11 sub-components of the clinical rating scale.
- **[Biotech]** **[Palisade Bio reports Phase 1b PALI-2108 data in Crohn's disease](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2112517590627041521)** — *BioStocks*
  - Presented translational and clinical evidence for PALI-2108 in inflammatory bowel disease at UEG Week 2026.
  - Data from a 5-patient Phase 1b cohort in Crohn’s disease showed a 47.5% reduction in mean endoscopic disease activity and a 58.8% reduction in mean fecal calprotectin after 14 days of treatment.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

- **[Biotech]** **[Roivant reports positive Phase results for lisraya in uveitis](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/21/roivant-immune-drug-lisraya-noninfectious-uveitis-trial-results/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT*
  - Roivant announced positive clinical trial results for its immune-modulating drug lisraya in non-infectious uveitis, pointing toward a potential new ophthalmic indication.
- **[Biotech]** **[Revolution Medicines begins dosing in Phase 3 NSCLC trial of zoldonrasib](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2112515123281907935)** — *BioStocks*
  - Dosed the first patients in the Phase 3 RASolve 308 trial evaluating zoldonrasib.
  - The study is investigating zoldonrasib as a first-line treatment for patients with metastatic RAS G12D-mutated non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
- **[Biotech]** **[ImmunityBio achieves database lock for registrational Anktiva trial in NMIBC](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2112877529920860256)** — *BioStocks*
  - Announced database lock for its registrational trial evaluating Anktiva in combination with BCG in BCG-naïve non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC).
  - Expects topline data in November and remains on track for a supplemental BLA (sBLA) submission in Q4.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

- **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA approves bepirovirsen for chronic hepatitis B](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-its-kind-chronic-hepatitis-b-treatment)** — *FDA*
  - The agency approved Hibsago (bepirovirsen) injection as the first antisense oligonucleotide for chronic HBV, indicated in combination with existing antivirals for adults without cirrhosis who have suppressed viral loads and HBsAg levels ≤3,000 IU/mL.
- **[Biotech]** **[FDA issues generic hormone patch approval](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-once-weekly-generic-hormone-therapy-patch-women)** — *FDA*
  - Granted approval for the first generic version of Climara Pro (estradiol and levonorgestrel transdermal system, 0.045 mg/0.015 mg per day), a once-weekly patch for menopausal women with an intact uterus.
- **[FDA issues final guidance on drug-connected prescription apps and software](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-issues-final-guidance-prescription-drug-apps-and-software)** — *FDA*
  - Finalized policy detailing regulatory requirements for mobile apps and software intended for use alongside prescription medicines.
  - Clarifies when app content requires FDA review, what submission materials are required by CDER, and when software must be incorporated into official drug labeling.

5. **Business & Strategy**

- **[Big Pharma]** **[Roche strikes $1.5B antibody-drug conjugate deal in China](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/20/biotech-news-roches-15b-hunt-for-new-drugs-in-china/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT*
  - Hansoh Pharmaceutical Group announced a major partnership with Roche to develop a portfolio of novel antibody-drug conjugates originating from China.
- **[Biotech]** **[Mark Cuban's Cost Plus targets rare disease manufacturing](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/21/mark-cuban-cost-plus-drugs-rare-disease-medicines/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT*
  - Cost Plus Drugs announced initiatives to cut manufacturing overhead for custom rare disease medications and n-of-1 gene therapies.
- **[Biotech]** **[Yakira Capital calls for strategic review and spending cuts at Avidity Biosciences](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2112519440776491435)** — *BioStocks*
  - Investor Yakira Capital urged Avidity Biosciences to curb cash expenditure and launch a formal strategic review.
  - The demand follows a $50 million dilutive financing completed after shares dropped approximately 44% to a valuation near 50% of net cash.
- **[OpenAI advances biopharma agent efforts with Orchestra](https://x.com/bradloncar/status/2112616231261884464)** — *Brad Loncar*
  - Biotech commentator Brad Loncar reported a strategic move by OpenAI to work with the Orchestra team to deploy AI agents in drug development.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

- **[Nigeria confirms imported Ebola case](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/21/health-news-nigeria-travel-related-ebola-case-outbreak/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT*
  - Nigeria identified an imported case linked to the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, making it the fifth country affected by the current transmission chain.
- **[Lawmakers press FDA on peptide loopholes](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/20/health-policy-news-bipartisan-group-of-lawmaker-urges-fda-to-close-peptide-loophole/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT*
  - A bipartisan group of legislators urged the agency to close regulatory loopholes enabling the unauthorized importation of knockoff versions of Eli Lilly's investigational obesity drug retatrutide.
- **[ICER publishes 2022-2025 new drug launch pricing analysis](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/icer-new-drug-launch-prices-report-2022-2025/833468)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - Report found two-thirds of newly launched prescription drugs evaluated by ICER exceeded cost-effectiveness thresholds, with inflation-adjusted median net launch prices climbing from $190,000 in 2022 to $257,000 in 2025.

**Worth watching:** Topline readouts expected in November for ImmunityBio's registrational Anktiva trial in NMIBC ahead of a planned Q4 sBLA submission, alongside FDA's next steps following bipartisan congressional pressure on retatrutide import loopholes.
